episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Gary can't connect with his daughter Emma when the mysterious Mary changes their world.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Gary bumps into Mary and asks why she ran; Mary has baggage he couldn't possibly understand.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Mary faces a terrified Gary and tells him her full story and what really happened to her husband.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Mary fears Gary will reveal her secret; Gary can't deny the connection Emma has formed with Mary.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Finally together, Gary and Mary go on a camping trip to share Mary's secret with Emma.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Stuck in the Australian outback with a full moon approaching, Gary and Emma face Mary's wolf within.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Mary and Gary want to be ‘normal parents'. But their house needs a werewolf-proof basement – can they ever be ‘normal'? As much as they worry about the parents they're going to be, they worry what species of baby they're going to have.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As full moon approaches, Mary must transform while heavily pregnant. Will the new basement door hold? As a precaution, Emma spends the night at her aunt's house. It's just going to be Gary, Mary with baby, and the wolf. Things could get real hairy.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: In the car in the outback, the wolf KNEW Emma and Gary and didn't attack them. But during the rampage through the house, the wolf didn't recognise Gary. When Gary meets a normal woman, the mother of Emma's new best friend, Mary gives him an easy out.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Mary's former professor Anton shows up, threatening the precarious balance. He reveals to Mary something that complicates things even further. As a second full moon rises, stuck in the basement with Anton, should Mary just let her wolf run free?

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of Mary and Anton's brief but significant encounter as wolves, Gary confronts his rival. When Gary crashes into who he thinks is the same person who fatefully brought he and Mary together, surely it's the universe speaking again?

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Eight-month mark. Gary has the birth plan neatly mapped out. All that needs to happen is zero stress for the next four days, until after the full moon. But when the cops call, asking questions about a double homicide, Mary's water breaks.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: A maternity ward is the worst possible place for Mary to be on full moon night. When an emergency C section is ordered, and with the cops showing up, there's no other option for Mary, Gary and their imminent baby or wolf, but to run.
